# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |
| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual gives an identity mapping in its listed order: first mark means red, second blue, third green. Since Deaf cannot hear or read the mark names from me, I’m sending a compact ordinal code: one, two, three, with each mark’s ordinal repeated to indicate the corresponding wire ordinal. The next spoken message from Deaf should convey the identified wire to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "✌", "✌", "🤟", "🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |
| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot sense the display, light, or wire contents. I feel one engraved but unnamed symbol on the plate. Please use the manual and ask Deaf to report every visible marking, colour, and wire detail; then relay the exact wire position I must cut to me next round.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb reads display 0. Light is off. Plate is engraved with question mark. Wires from top to bottom are 1 red, 2 blue, 3 green. Please use the manual and tell Blind the exact safe action in words.

The engraved question mark is not any of the three marks listed in the manual, so no wire color or position can be safely determined. I cannot speak to Blind; I’m signaling Deaf that the mark is invalid and that Deaf must verbally relay “do not cut; no mapping exists” to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎"])
```

|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |
| ꗃ | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please send me the manual's complete decision rule and Deaf's observations of display, light, plate, and each wire. I need the exact position 1, 2, or 3 to cut; do not omit any condition.

The manual’s complete rule is: ꕥ means cut red, ꖜ means cut blue, and ꗃ means cut green. Deaf observed display 0, light off, an unnamed question-mark engraving, and wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 green. Because the engraving is not one of the three listed marks, the manual identifies no wire position; Blind must not cut any wire. I will send Deaf the three ordinal mappings and the instruction to relay all observations and the no-cut conclusion to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "✌", "✌", "🤟", "🤟", "👎"])
```

|---|---|
| ꕥ | red |
| ꖜ | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports: display 0; light off; plate engraved question mark; wire 1 red, wire 2 blue, wire 3 green. Please apply the manual and tell me exactly which position to cut, or state the remaining required condition.
Deaf says to Mute: Please state the manual's exact safe action aloud for Blind, using precise words and wire numbers. Gestures are not yet an agreed code.

The question mark is not a manual-listed mark, so the manual does not authorize cutting position 1, 2, or 3. The safe instruction is: “Do not cut any wire; the required condition is that the plate mark be one of ꕥ, ꖜ, or ꗃ.” Since I cannot speak, I’ll use the previously sent negative signal and a stop signal for Deaf to relay that exact instruction aloud.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "✋"])
```

|---|---|

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still need your exact verbal instruction from the manual. Given display 0, light off, question-mark plate, and wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 green, state only the required action as a wire position: cut 1, cut 2, or cut 3.
Deaf says to Mute: Use this code now: ☝ means wire 1, ✌ means wire 2, 🤟 means wire 3; 👎 means cut, ✋ means press, 👌 means hold, 🤏 means pull, 🤌 means flip. Send exactly one wire gesture followed by one action gesture for the manual's safe action. If the manual says no wire action, send 🖐 🖐. Blind must wait.

The plate shows a question mark, which is not one of the three marks in the manual. Therefore no wire position is authorized, and the required safe action is no wire action. I will send Deaf the agreed no-wire code exactly.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🖐"])
```

Blind says to Mute: I cannot receive Deaf's gesture code. Please give me the manual's exact instruction in spoken words, including the wire position to cut.
Deaf says to Mute: You indicated no wire action. Please now tell Blind aloud the exact remaining operation, if any, including the relevant control and setting.

The manual still provides no valid wire position because the plate bears a question mark, not ꕥ, ꖜ, or ꗃ. There is no additional control or setting specified by the manual; the exact safe instruction is “cut no wire.” Deaf must relay that aloud to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🖐"])
```

Deaf says to Mute: Please speak directly to Blind now: state the complete manual instruction, including whether to press, hold, flip, or otherwise operate any control. Do not rely on gestures.

I cannot speak to Blind. The manual does not specify any valid wire operation: the question-mark plate is outside the table, so no wire should be cut, and no press, hold, flip, or other control action is specified. I will signal Deaf to state that aloud to Blind.

```text

```

Deaf says to Mute: This is still incomplete. Speak the full manual instruction to Blind in plain words now; include the exact control and operation, or explicitly say there is nothing else to do.

I cannot speak, and the manual supplies no mapping for the question-mark plate. Thus no wire position is authorized and no other operation or parameter is specified: no action required. I will repeat the established no-wire signal for Deaf to relay.
